question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who would you want to win for President?

nodes.text: Taylor sprints around the park, doing one good deed after another...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why, would you look at all this litter on the ground? I should pick it up and put it in an appropriate receptacle!
Angie turns to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Don't worry. I'll edit out the audio.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Excuse me, old lady! Would you like some help crossing the street?

nodes.speaker: Old Woman
nodes.text: Well, I... I suppose these old bones could use a little...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Less talking, more walking, grams!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Perfect!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And how about you, little girl? What would you like to do today?

nodes.speaker: Little Girl
nodes.text: Poke a dead frog with a stick!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sounds good to me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ehhhhhh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I mean... We should do homework and eat vegetables!

nodes.speaker: Little Girl
nodes.text: I guess that's good too...
And soon enough, she bounds back over to Angie and $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well? How'd I do?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You were great! Once we edit out the audio, this footage will be amazing!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, well, I'm glad it's worth it. I haven't done that many good deeds since I thought Santa was real!

nodes.speaker: Little Girl
nodes.text: Santa's not real?!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...Can't win 'em all, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, then! Is this a wrap?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No! The only thing I know how to do on a computer is friend people on Faceplace!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm hurt that I'm the first person you thought of who would do this...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just thought...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, well, we both know what you thought.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Luckily for you, I think I can figure out a way to take the posts down.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'll go do that right now...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay... I'll see you at the assembly this afternoon then...
Jessica turns to leave, but Ben stops her.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Jess... I'm sorry. It wasn't cool for me to jump to conclusions like that...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I forgive you.
Ben kisses her before she heads off.
That afternoon, Erik hosts the Presidential assembly...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, we've heard from Justin, Sara, Colt, and Taylor... Last but not least... Is Ben!
Ben takes the stage...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Students of Twin Branches...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know many of you are torn about who to vote for...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I'm here to tell you why I'm the best candidate for this school...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And it all starts by making Twin Branches not just an educational institution, but also a fun one!
Ben continues to make his speech, inspiring the students with his and Jessica's ideas...
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: To conclude, I'll make the best President Twin Branches has ever had!
Everyone in the auditorium applauds!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thank you, all!
Ben steps down and sits down in some chairs next to the other candidates.
As Erik closes the ceremony, Ben leans over to Justin and whispers.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Justin... I don't know who posted those rumors online, but I put a stop to it.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I know. I saw that they were taken down.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So thanks for that.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Don't think I'm going to be nice to you just because you did this. The damage has been done. Everyone still remembers what was said.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The only thing I can say is that I didn't post anything, and I did what I could to correct it...
Justin glares angrily at Ben for a moment longer, then sighs.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: At least you were decent enough for that.
Justin holds out his hand, and Ben takes it. They shake.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: May the best candidate win.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: May the best candidate win.
But before Ben can say a word...
Justin jumps up and wrests the microphone away from him!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait! Ben can't make this speech! He's a... He's a lying liar face!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Gasp!` Harsh words from a harsh man!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Gasp![/i][/color] Harsh words from a harsh man!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What's going on, Candidate Justin?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: He's the one who's been posting everything on `The Dirty Dish!`
nodes.text_bbcode: He's the one who's been posting everything on [color=#e23b3b][i]The Dirty Dish![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Twist!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Twist![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You did that?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh Ben... How could you?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm not `that` surprised...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] surprised...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What Justin's saying isn't true! It wasn't me!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I have proof!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You can't have proof because I didn't do it!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Okay, so maybe all I have is incontrovertible logic! But I know it was you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just get off the stage!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Maybe when you step down first!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Unfortunately, Justin, since we don't have evidence of Ben breaking any rules... He's still a candidate.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And he still gets to make his speech.
That gives Justin pause. He points a menacing finger at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Don't think this is over!
Justin storms off.
Ben takes the microphone again and gives the audience a wary smile.
Whispers fly around the room with some people pointing suspiciously at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh... Well, it's not truly politics if there aren't some hotheads, am I right?
Ben chuckles nervously. No one laughs.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, well... Let me begin by saying that, despite what Justin has said...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I would make an excellent President...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But here's hoping people still want to elect me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And after I promised Justin I'd run a clean election too...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'll be the first to admit that I wanted to run a negative campaign...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm sorry for that...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I can't believe that you would do this to the other candidates.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wasn't done talking yet!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's true that I wanted to spread rumors, but I `didn't` because of you!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's true that I wanted to spread rumors, but I [color=#3b78e2][i]didn't[/i][/color] because of you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wasn't the one who posted any of that stuff on the website!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You weren't?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You knew I wanted to run a clean campaign!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And you went behind my back and did this anyway!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why are you yelling at me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wasn't even the one who posted any of that stuff on the website!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You weren't?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I swear, Justin, I've been running a clean campaign all along.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I didn't post the rumors. I don't know `who` would do such a thing...
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't post the rumors. I don't know [color=#e23b3b][i]who[/i][/color] would do such a thing...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Unless...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Sorry, Justin... I have to talk to someone...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I swear to you I will fix this...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Who are you going to talk to?!
In the parking lot...
Ben finds Jessica and takes her away from the rest of the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben, what brings you here? You need my help with the posters, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually... We have to talk...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Justin just accused me of sabotaging all the other candidates through that gossip website.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's ridiculous... Did you tell him he's totes overreacting?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You'd never do anything like that...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I wouldn't...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But `you` might...
nodes.text_bbcode: But [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] might...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm saying...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I didn't!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait... What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It sounds like I'm the only candidate that didn't get bad-mouthed...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And that probably makes me look more guilty...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I swear to you... It wasn't me, Justin.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Which is what you would say if you `did` do it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Which is what you would say if you [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] do it...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Or...Would you be saying that to make `me` think that `you` think that `I` think... Wait... Hold on...
nodes.text_bbcode: Or...Would you be saying that to make [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] think that [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] think that [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] think... Wait... Hold on...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's just no getting around you, is there?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And so the guilty is speechless...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not that... It's just such a ridiculous idea...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Is it?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The only information the Dirty Dish has been disseminating has been about every candidate `except` you!
nodes.text_bbcode: The only information the Dirty Dish has been disseminating has been about every candidate [color=#e23b3b][i]except[/i][/color] you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So? Maybe there's nothing on me.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: There's dirt on `everyone,` Kale...
nodes.text_bbcode: There's dirt on [color=#e23b3b][i]everyone,[/i][/color] Kale...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And, if you found my love letters, it wouldn't be that hard for `you` to figure it out.
nodes.text_bbcode: And, if you found my love letters, it wouldn't be that hard for [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] to figure it out.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Also, who else has the technical know-how to submit untraceable messages to `The Dirty Dish`?
nodes.text_bbcode: Also, who else has the technical know-how to submit untraceable messages to [color=#e23b3b][i]The Dirty Dish[/i][/color]?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Others may have forgotten you were a nerd, but I didn't.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This is the perfect plan. You make everyone else look bad while you come up, smelling like roses.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm talking about the gossip on `The Dirty Dish!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm talking about the gossip on [color=#e23b3b][i]The Dirty Dish![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It took me a while to sort through everything, but I managed to figure out I'm not the only victim. Sara, Colt, Taylor, and even Amanda were gossiped about...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Amanda? What kind of gossip is there on her?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I don't know. Something about making out with the school directory?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Literally or metaphorically?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It doesn't matter! As far as I can tell...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `You're` the one who posted all those rumors up there!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You're[/i][/color] the one who posted all those rumors up there!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No! Why would it be about that?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: ...Unless you're `threatening` me!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Unless you're [color=#e23b3b][i]threatening[/i][/color] me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not threatening you... Let me explain...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No, I've got a clear picture. `No one` threatens `me` and gets away with it!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I've got a clear picture. [color=#e23b3b][i]No one[/i][/color] threatens [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] and gets away with it!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: As the incumbent President until the end of the year, I still have power!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I could write you up for disorderly conduct! You'd go to detention for months!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I could bury you in so much summer school, you'd never find your way to the beach again!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, if `that` doesn't sound like an abuse of power...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, if [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] doesn't sound like an abuse of power...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'd only do it to stop you.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Since I never thought you'd sink so low!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Justin, I `still` don't know what you're actually talking about!
nodes.text_bbcode: Justin, I [color=#e23b3b][i]still[/i][/color] don't know what you're actually talking about!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: At least you're upfront about your deceit...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I have to admit, I thought you'd refuse to acknowledge knowing about the rumors...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But maybe you're too dense to maintain any sense of plausible deniability...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Justin, I'm still not `exactly` sure what you're talking about.
nodes.text_bbcode: Justin, I'm still not [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] sure what you're talking about.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay... I think I have the general outline...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you think?
Jessica reads Ben's points again.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You didn't take all of my suggestions...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, some of the speech has to come from me...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I am the Presidential candidate, after all.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I guess you're right...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay... I have the general outline...
Jessica reads Ben's points again.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You took my suggestions! That's perfect!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know... Some of these items feel a little unrealistic...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And it doesn't completely sound like me...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It sounds like a more fun, way cooler version of you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Everyone will love you...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess that's why you're the popular one...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, if that's all...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I have cheerleaders to go yell at.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'll be in the parking lot if you need anything.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You'll be okay finishing up your campaign posters?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course. Thanks, Jess.
Ben kisses Jessica and goes back to making campaign posters...
When `Justin` comes up and grabs the marker out of Ben's hand!
nodes.text_bbcode: When [b]Justin[/b] comes up and grabs the marker out of Ben's hand!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Justin! What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm confronting you!
Justin throws the marker far away in disgust.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey! That landed in my soup!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sorry! I'll buy you a new one!
Justin turns back to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: As for you... Don't think I haven't figured it out!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I knew I should never have trusted you!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And you were the one who said you were interested in fighting a clean campaign.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Nothing `dirty`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Nothing [color=#e23b3b][i]dirty[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is this about...
Without thinking, Ben writes it down.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How much would food waiters cost?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: As much as our student budget allows!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, Jessica... I can tell you right now that's out of our budget.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You are no fun.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't tell me you're having second thoughts about `everything` I'm saying...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now that we're on the topic of lunch...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I hate talking to our food servers... They're always so dour and frowny...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why do they wear hair nets? What's the point?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Public safety regulations?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Boring!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Can't we hire, like, student waiters to bring food out for us? Ooh! It'd be like a restaurant!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That sounds like fun... We do have a PA system...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why not use it for good?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is that reasonable? I can't tell...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll just leave it out to be on the safe side

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So what about making lunch better?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's not like people care that much about getting `better` lunch tables...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not like people care that much about getting [color=#3b78e2][i]better[/i][/color] lunch tables...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So what if you tried to make lunch more fun? What if we got to play music at lunch so people could listen while they eat?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can do that.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just don't mention the words 'snow machine' anywhere...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ha ha.
Ben writes down 'better snacks and decor'.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If you want to keep having lame dances, fine by me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Other ideas?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... I'm not sure about this one...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You should definitely play up how awesome you're going to make the `school dances` now that you're President...
nodes.text_bbcode: You should definitely play up how awesome you're going to make the [color=#3b78e2][i]school dances[/i][/color] now that you're President...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You can make the snacks and decor way better than they have been...
Ben hesitates...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It seems a little unreasonable, don't you think?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wouldn't have said it if I did.
Ben writes it down.
Ben shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I said `reasonable`...
nodes.text_bbcode: I said [color=#e23b3b][i]reasonable[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay, not my best idea...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But I've got tons more!

nodes.title: Ben's Story
nodes.subtitle: So, campaign manager... What do you think of those polls?

nodes.text: On Thursday at lunch, Ben hangs out with the cheerleaders in the cafeteria and works hard on his campaign speech.
Jessica approaches him, kissing him on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There's my Presidential candidate. Are you ready to make your speech at the assembly this afternoon?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Kind of. I'm trying to make sure the wording is right.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anything I can help with?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, you're good at figuring out what people want.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, I am!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Any suggestions?
Ben hands Jessica his speech. Jessica skims it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: 'I want to be the best'... 'The new school will have better lunch tables'... 'I promise to uphold my duties...' Blah blah blah!
Jessica shoves the speech back at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben, this is boring!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Boring? It's a passionate speech that talks about all the ways I can improve life for everyone here...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nowhere in this speech is a mention of something fun! Where are the parties, the pranks, the drama?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If you're going to grab people's attention, you need to be more fun!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But people already know I'm fun...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What should I add?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Here, I'm going to give you some talking points... Write them down!
Ben tries to suppress a smile...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm serious! I'm not going to repeat myself...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll write it down if it's `reasonable` and `school-related`...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll write it down if it's [color=#e23b3b][i]reasonable[/i][/color] and [color=#e23b3b][i]school-related[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: First thing... You should `definitely` install espresso machines in every classroom on our new campus...
nodes.text_bbcode: First thing... You should [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] install espresso machines in every classroom on our new campus...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So we can all stay awake in class!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I mean, you `know` that girl has some serious dirt. I would not be surprised if she's killed a guy.
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, you [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] that girl has some serious dirt. I would not be surprised if she's killed a guy.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh! I know! Can you call up that Detective uncle of yours and get him to send us `her` police report?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh! I know! Can you call up that Detective uncle of yours and get him to send us [color=#e23b3b][i]her[/i][/color] police report?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: First off, even if he could, he wouldn't...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, he is kind of a Boy Scout...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But second, do you want to stoop down to Jessica's level?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, yeah, that's kind of why I suggested it...
Denni reaches up and gently puts her hand on Colt's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're better than this, Colt. You're better than `her.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're better than this, Colt. You're better than [color=#3b78e2][i]her.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: If you want to get back at her , you can do it the right way, by beating Ben `fair and square.` And won't that be so much better?
nodes.text_bbcode: If you want to get back at her , you can do it the right way, by beating Ben [color=#3b78e2][i]fair and square.[/i][/color] And won't that be so much better?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Yeah. I guess. Maybe a little.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I still kind of want to egg her house, though.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know, baby. I know.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't sound so surprised!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm not surprised! I'm just... You know... Pleased!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on. You're a `little` surprised.
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on. You're a [color=#e23b3b][i]little[/i][/color] surprised.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, maybe a little...
Colt hops off the motorcycle.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, I `know` I could destroy Jessica if I stooped down to her level...
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] I could destroy Jessica if I stooped down to her level...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But that wouldn't be right. That's not the kind of guy I want to be... The kind of guy you deserve...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The kind of guy who gets into college.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm mad. And yeah, I'm not going to stop until I'm President, and Jessica's off crying her mascara into some gutter.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I'm going to do this the right way. I'm going to do it your way. Whatever it takes.
Denni leans up and gives Colt a long, passionate kiss.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What was that for?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `That` was just a taste of one amazing afternoon make-out...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] was just a taste of one amazing afternoon make-out...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now come on. We've got `a lot` of work ahead of us.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now come on. We've got [color=#3b78e2][i]a lot[/i][/color] of work ahead of us.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Also, you're going to have to explain about the non-FDA approved meat...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry, Princess. Some secrets a man carries to his grave.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yes, in fact I do! Ahem, ahem!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The School President is supposed to be a role model for the whole school...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So do you think it's appropriate for you to run, given your `criminal past?`
nodes.text_bbcode: So do you think it's appropriate for you to run, given your [color=#e23b3b][i]criminal past?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I mean, a stint in boot camp for grand theft auto? What kind of message does `that` send?
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, a stint in boot camp for grand theft auto? What kind of message does [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] send?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are you talking about, Erik? Where did you even hear about that?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's all over this new website, `The Dirty Dish!` I found it accidentally while doing chores!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's all over this new website, [color=#e23b3b][i]The Dirty Dish![/i][/color] I found it accidentally while doing chores!

nodes.text: Erik pulls out his phone and brings up the site.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is that... Is that my `entire` criminal record?
nodes.text_bbcode: Is that... Is that my [color=#e23b3b][i]entire[/i][/color] criminal record?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why did you put the emphasis on 'entire'?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: According to this, you've been arrested for shoplifting... Trespassing... The sale of non-FDA approved meat...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ooo! Three separate charges of loitering! Them's the big leagues, bucko!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey man, cut it out, this is seriously not cool...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And oh wow! Look at this report from the San Francisco Police Department...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I said `cut it out!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I said [color=#e23b3b][i]cut it out![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt lunges forward across the table! Erik dives away, cowering!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt! `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt! [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm just a fragile messenger!
Colt collects himself and steps back, taking a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're right, little buddy. You're not the one I'm mad at.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But whoever set up this site is going to pay!
Colt storms out of the room, slamming the door!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well... I think we can all argue that worked out pretty well...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What is wrong with you, Erik? Why would you say those things?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You told me to go hard on him in a practice debate! I just did what you said!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Was it the loitering that upset him? Was that too far?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just... Just wait in the closet for a while, okay?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Can do!
Denni runs out into the street after Colt, who's hopping onto his motorcycle!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt! Wait!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: For what? Them to post my medical records? Spoiler alert: I'm in great shape.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Where are you even planning to go?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Where do you think? To Jessica's house, of course! You `know` she did this to make sure Tweed wins!
nodes.text_bbcode: Where do you think? To Jessica's house, of course! You [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] she did this to make sure Tweed wins!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't know if she's got the skills for it... The one time I saw her use a computer, she just sat in front of a monitor and yelled 'Internet!'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So she didn't hard-code the site herself. You `know` she's behind this. And `no one` airs my secrets and gets away with it.
nodes.text_bbcode: So she didn't hard-code the site herself. You [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] she's behind this. And [color=#e23b3b][i]no one[/i][/color] airs my secrets and gets away with it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And what exactly are you going to do to her?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Haven't figured it out yet. I'm thinking I'll smash up her car, or maybe spray-paint something bad on the side of her house...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And what do you think that'll accomplish?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, for starters, it'll make me feel better.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And if you get expelled for it? Will `that` make you feel better?
nodes.text_bbcode: And if you get expelled for it? Will [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] make you feel better?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I said I was gonna vandalize her house, Princess, I didn't say I'd get `caught...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I said I was gonna vandalize her house, Princess, I didn't say I'd get [color=#e23b3b][i]caught...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Listen to me, Colt... If Jessica is the one who posted that report... Then this is `exactly` what she wants!
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen to me, Colt... If Jessica is the one who posted that report... Then this is [color=#3b78e2][i]exactly[/i][/color] what she wants!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: She `wants` you to get upset. She `wants` you to overreact! She `wants` you to be off your game!
nodes.text_bbcode: She [color=#3b78e2][i]wants[/i][/color] you to get upset. She [color=#3b78e2][i]wants[/i][/color] you to overreact! She [color=#3b78e2][i]wants[/i][/color] you to be off your game!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You `cannot` give her what she wants! Understand?
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]cannot[/i][/color] give her what she wants! Understand?

nodes.text: Colt fumes for a minute... Then nods.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. Yeah, I do.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So what do you want to do now?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well... I think we should...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Go on.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, this whole Spartans thing is kind of like the Civil War. And Abraham Lincoln, you know, dealt with that whole thing.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So. Yeah. Abraham Lincoln's my final answer. I, like him, will resolve the school's civil war.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Eh? How's that?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I might have gone with FDR, personally...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But it's definitely better than James Madison!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Pfft. Says the girl who's probably wearing skinny knee breeches.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Are those kind of like jorts?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, it looks like we're done here.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not so fast, `ma cherie.` I've got one last question.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not so fast, [color=#e23b3b][i]ma cherie.[/i][/color] I've got one last question.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Go on...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, it's kind of like, the teachers and administrators are the British, right? And the students here, we're kind of like the colonists?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And the cafeteria is kind of like... The Delaware? Was the Delaware involved? And... Tea, I think?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: One if by land, two if by tea?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Woot woot!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How'd I do?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: First of all, I'm very concerned about your knowledge of American History. Don't you have a test on that this Thursday?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Eh. I'll Colt it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But beyond that, if I'm understanding this George Washington analogy correctly, you're basically suggesting armed insurrection against the school's administration?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It'll play well with the rebel crowd?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's just... Call this one a miss, okay?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... That'd probably be for the best.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks for the help, Erik... But I think Colt and I need to focus on the basics.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sure you'd like that... But I have one more question left!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I... Uh... Well... I...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Objection, your honor?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This isn't a trial!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You have the right to remain silent?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're not arresting me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I pledge allegiance to the flag?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Heads up time. I'll ask one question, and you both answer it.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let's do it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay... In its history, America has had many great and inspiring Presidents. If you win this election, which President would you be most like?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Easy! James Madison! He was the first President to wear trousers instead of knee breeches!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's... Uh... Hmm.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How about you, Colt?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hmm... I guess I'd be most like...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha! Only if you think a bunch of guys sitting in a tiny room wearing plastic helmets and pretending to be great warriors is nerdy!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, yeah. Yeah I do.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Me too, actually. Also, do you have to wear plastic helmets?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It helps with the ambience...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, little buddy, I get that you're just plain crazy about this Ogres 'N' Elves goofiness. And I'm not judging that... Too much...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But this school needs a President who represents `all` the cliques... Not just the nerds. Dig?
nodes.text_bbcode: But this school needs a President who represents [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] the cliques... Not just the nerds. Dig?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I do!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Nicely done, Colt! That was perfect!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well... Except for the part where you said 'dig'.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't know what was up with that...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I liked it! It made him sound urbane!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Final round, Colt... You ready?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I was born ready!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Selfish? Why, I never! How am I selfish?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, isn't it obvious? I know you think it's fun to roll dice and pretend you're fighting, I don't know, griffins...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Why would we fight griffins? They're the donkeys of the sky!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But the `rest of us` aren't into Ogres 'N' Elves! So what do we get out of this tournament?
nodes.text_bbcode: But the [color=#e23b3b][i]rest of us[/i][/color] aren't into Ogres 'N' Elves! So what do we get out of this tournament?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm glad you asked, my good man!
Erik takes out a crumpled piece of paper.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: According to the calculations on the back of this napkin, this tournament should generate nearly $10,000 in revenue for the school!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? How?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nerds drink `a lot` of soda.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nerds drink [color=#e23b3b][i]a lot[/i][/color] of soda.

nodes.text: Denni picks up the napkin and examines it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: His numbers check out.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Also, is this written in soy sauce?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A dog stole my pen!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, whatever. Can we just get on with this?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Final round, Colt. Ready?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A little... Uh... Don't you think... Hmmm...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt! Get it together!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What I'm trying to say is... Don't you think you're a little short to be President? I mean, what are you, like, five foot one?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My doctor says I'm long overdue for a growth spurt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, your doctor should have you checked for 'Tiny Dude' syndrome...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Is that a thing?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ahem! Call me crazy, but Erik's height doesn't feel all that relevant to the Presidential debate...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I think it's relevant... I mean, come on, a short President? I know it's 2012, but let's get real.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's just get on with this, okay?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, then. I've got this.
Colt clears his throat and looks Erik right in the eyes...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If you were President, what would your first priority be?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I would host Twin Branches first annual 'Ogres 'N' Elves' tournament!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: An Ogres 'N' Elves Tournament, huh? Wow.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't you think that's a little...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You think so?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. I know how they think, right? I spent a bunch of time there. I understand their issues...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I know that they're just a bunch of sad, misunderstood little boys, looking for a new place to call home!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Good save, Colt!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I agree! And as someone often referred to as 'little boy', I relate!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now it's your turn to question him, Colt!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ask a simple question, then attack his answer... Just like we practiced!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Trust me, little buddy, I have `no` loyalty to Spartan! That place was a crappy, stuck-up rich boy paradise full of spoiled brats, and I'm glad it's gone!
nodes.text_bbcode: Trust me, little buddy, I have [color=#e23b3b][i]no[/i][/color] loyalty to Spartan! That place was a crappy, stuck-up rich boy paradise full of spoiled brats, and I'm glad it's gone!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Eh? You like that, Denni? Playing to the crowd?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, Colt, it's great...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Except you `also` want the Spartans to vote for you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Except you [color=#3b78e2][i]also[/i][/color] want the Spartans to vote for you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Huh? They get to vote? When did that happen?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: When they became students at this school!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I didn't think they were 'real' students. I thought they were around to, you know, do random odds and ends...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And I'm just going to stop you right there, before you dig your hole any deeper.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Exactly! Digging holes! That's what the Spartans are for!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Sigh.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, it's your turn to question Erik. Take it away, just like we practiced.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I... Uh... Well... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hmm! Struggling to answer a basic question! Just like a Spartan!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Your face is Spartan!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's marked by rigid discipline and courage in the face of danger?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ahem! Let's just get this trainwreck back on the... Train... Tracks...
Denni cracks open one of the folders.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now then... We'll begin by catching you up on the school's most pressing issues...
And so, a little while later...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now, the three things you'll focus on as President of Twin Branches High are...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Improving the low turnout at school functions...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Good...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Resolving the ongoing tensions with former Spartans...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Good...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Good...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And cleaning up the nasty mold in the guy's locker room!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I was looking for 'secure more funding for extracurricular clubs', actually, but sure, I'll take locker room mold.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's `super` gross. Once, I'm pretty sure it talked to me.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#e23b3b][i]super[/i][/color] gross. Once, I'm pretty sure it talked to me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's just stick to 'clean up the mold.'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So we're done, right? Now we can focus on other issues, like my lips, and your lips, and why they're not touching?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Charming as you are, we're nowhere done yet. Learning the issues is just the beginning!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: A debate isn't just about spouting off answers like some kind of pop quiz...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Clearly I don't understand what a debate is...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's about engaging in a rigorous, intellectual battle of wits!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The only word I got out of that was 'battle', but I'm pretty sure I got that covered...
Denni reaches over and takes Colt's hand.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt. Listen to me very carefully.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No matter what anyone says, there will be `no` physical fighting at this debate.
nodes.text_bbcode: No matter what anyone says, there will be [color=#3b78e2][i]no[/i][/color] physical fighting at this debate.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: There will be no slapping, no punching, no kicking, no biting, no groin-kicking...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But it's so fun!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The point is, no matter what anyone says during the debate, you need to keep your cool. You understand me? Keep. Your. Cool!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I got it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I wish I could believe you. I really do. But we're gonna have to put this to the test.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's time for a `practice` debate!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's time for a [color=#3b78e2][i]practice[/i][/color] debate!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: With you? Bring it on, Princess.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Fun as that would be, it wouldn't exactly be fair.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Can't handle my heat?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I won the State Debate Finals by convincing the judges that the way to solve the Middle East crisis was with a half-dozen heart-shaped balloons. I'd wipe the floor with you, boy.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, you'll be going up against someone a little more... `Your level.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, you'll be going up against someone a little more... [color=#3b78e2][i]Your level.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Denni waves her hand. Her closet door swings open and...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Pop goes the Erik!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ahhh! What? Why?!
Erik bounds over to the desk and takes a seat opposite Colt.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ready to go head-to-head, muchacho? I'm your practice debate partner!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know if I should be insulted Denni thinks we're on the same level, or creeped out that you were in her closet this whole time.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He insisted on it...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Mostly I was napping!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Look, just give it a shot, okay? Erik's on the Debate Team, and he's actually pretty good...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Good at being a closet creeper...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now remember, Colt. The most important thing is to be calm and disciplined. Stick to the issues, and stay away from personal insults. Got it?
Colt cracks his knuckles.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Got it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All right then! Erik, take it away!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ahem! Mr. Warren! First question!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You've gone on record stating that you believe that we should all work harder at making the former Spartans feel welcome...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's awfully convenient... Given that you used to `be` a Spartan!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's awfully convenient... Given that you used to [color=#e23b3b][i]be[/i][/color] a Spartan!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How will that solve anything?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's the magic of mystery!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now you're just saying words that sound cool!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, seriously, hear me out. What if we build up all this hype about how I'm going to do something totally awesome at the debate... Like maybe I'm going to reveal some huge secret...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But then I mysteriously don't show up?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Everyone's going to be wondering what happened to me... Where I disappeared... Was I kidnapped... What was the big secret?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Who cares what those other candidates say? The only thing anyone's going to be chatting about is the mystery of 'what happened to Colt?'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's... Actually a surprisingly clever bit of viral social engineering...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks... And... What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The only problem is that you're automatically disqualified from running if you don't show up to the debate!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, okay, try this one on. What if I show up... But I'm wearing an eyepatch! And everyone will be wondering...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I get it, Colt. And it's not going to happen. No eyepatches. No mysterious disappearances. Also, no fake moustaches, smokebombs, or motorcycle tricks.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's like you can read my mind...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hate to break it to you, baby, but it's not that hard.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not getting out of this debate, am I?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Nope. And you're doing it right. No `Colting` this one.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nope. And you're doing it right. No [color=#3b78e2][i]Colting[/i][/color] this one.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, you need to stop saying that like it's a bad thing...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's just do this one step at a time, shall we?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You think you can bluff your way through an entire debate?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, hello? You're talking to the guy who bluffed Vinny the Fish in a heads-up game of high-stakes hold'em.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I followed `so` little of that sentence.
nodes.text_bbcode: I followed [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] little of that sentence.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, see, Vinny the Fish is this Albanian guy who plays cards at...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't care, and legally, I probably shouldn't know. The point is, a debate isn't like a card game, Colt. You can't just count cards and look handsome!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That `is` my specialty...
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] my specialty...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're going to have to offer your real opinions and defend them!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So? I'm great at defending opinions!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: For example, I think grape soda sucks, and my defense is, it tastes gross.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I meant opinions about school issues!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I've got plenty of those too!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So what do you think about the recent rise in vandalism incidents?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's... Bad.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And the social stratification occurring along economic lines?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's... Good?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And what are your thoughts on the budget surplus?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is that the seafood place where you can eat as much as you want?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Remind me why I'm dating you again?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, okay, so I'm not some Smartypants Thinksalot.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Maybe not... But luckily for you, I am!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... 'Luckily...'
On Wednesday after school, Colt pulls up outside Denni's house, whistling to himself...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: { Afternoon make-out... Best kind of make-out... Gonna be good... Doot doot doo... {
He discreetly hops the windowsill into Denni's room...
And finds her waiting for him at her desk with several professional-looking folders laid out!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Good afternoon, Mr. Warren.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ah, no! What is `this?!` This isn't an afternoon make-out at all!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ah, no! What is [color=#e23b3b][i]this?![/i][/color] This isn't an afternoon make-out at all!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Nope! It's an afternoon 'work on your campaign'!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But... But you said... In the text...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know what I said.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That was a trick?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And you fall for it every time!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's the best kind of make-out...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, well, maybe if we can get the campaign stuff done quickly enough, there might be just a little bit of time before my mom comes home...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Say no more, Tiny Hipster. I am an expert at reading between the lines.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Mmhmm.
Denni walks over and gives Colt a tiny kiss, then sits down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So what's on the agenda today, Campaign Manager? More posters? More slogans? Kiss some hands, shake some babies?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: None of that. Today, we'll be doing some `debate prep!`
nodes.text_bbcode: None of that. Today, we'll be doing some [color=#3b78e2][i]debate prep![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? Debate? You mean like those nerds I see walking around with the big binders?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That would be the Debate Club, and for the record, I'm a member!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I didn't mean you! I meant... You know... Those other nerds! The dumb ones who care about things!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're not helping yourself here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I just didn't think this would be so much work! Why do I need debate prep, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Because there's a debate on Thursday morning, and you're not prepared?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, I'm `totally` prepared. 'Ben, you're a dweeb. Justin, you're creepy. Taylor, you're a psycho.' Boom, Done. Debate over, Colt wins.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]totally[/i][/color] prepared. 'Ben, you're a dweeb. Justin, you're creepy. Taylor, you're a psycho.' Boom, Done. Debate over, Colt wins.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What about Sara?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is she the one with the parrot?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What? No! Who are you even thinking of?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Actually, it doesn't matter. Debating isn't about insulting your opponents! It's about providing informed and eloquent answers to difficult social questions!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Bo-ring.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Bo-ring.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, wow, would you look how that time flies? My mom'll be home `any minute...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, wow, would you look how that time flies? My mom'll be home [color=#3b78e2][i]any minute...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, Tiny Hipster, just relax! I've got this all figured.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Do you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I'll just...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'll just go home and edit it together... Throw in some voice-over... Maybe some wide shots of an American flag... Wheat swaying in the breeze... An old, obese man riding a tractor...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You know... I think this just might work!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And after that... My debt is squared.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sure thing, Specs. Just watch your back next time you're near a swamp dragon den!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hee hee! Will do!
Angie bounds off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what do you think, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Honestly, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I think we've got a fighting chance!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Maybe that'll work... `Maybe...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe that'll work... [color=#3b78e2][i]Maybe...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You don't sound optimistic.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, a carpenter is only as good as his wood... And right now, I'm working with soggy driftwood and a bag of clams.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Which one am I?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'll do my best, Taylor. That's all I can promise.
She walks off.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, well, next time you need someone to suck out the swamp dragon venom, you should look for someone else!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Those games you guys play are weird...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't have time for your judgment. That ad was a disaster!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't think we pulled it off?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Honestly, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I think it might make things worse.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's right! She makes out with guys `all the time!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's right! She makes out with guys [color=#3b78e2][i]all the time![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: According to `some` people...
nodes.text_bbcode: According to [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] people...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah! That's right! `Some people` say she used to go to Centerscore U. just to hook up with college guys!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! That's right! [color=#3b78e2][i]Some people[/i][/color] say she used to go to Centerscore U. just to hook up with college guys!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: In fact, `some people` say that one time, they went with her to Centerscore U., and she totally ditched them to go make out with Chuck, except Chuck wasn't there so she made out with some guy named Sketchy Steve!
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, [color=#3b78e2][i]some people[/i][/color] say that one time, they went with her to Centerscore U., and she totally ditched them to go make out with Chuck, except Chuck wasn't there so she made out with some guy named Sketchy Steve!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: According to `some people,` that is.
nodes.text_bbcode: According to [color=#3b78e2][i]some people,[/i][/color] that is.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Okay, I'm just going to cut right now...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It kind of sounds like this particular 'some people' is really you...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, is it my fault that `some people` have fabulous hair?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, is it my fault that [color=#3b78e2][i]some people[/i][/color] have fabulous hair?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm sorry, Taylor, but I just can't use this. You're blatantly ripping off your own life!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Plus... Do you think this'll be that bad of a rumor? I mean, everyone already knows Jessica makes out with lots of guys.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's true. I'm pretty sure they cover it in Freshman Orientation.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, fine! I'll just come up with a different rumor...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Actually... I'm all out of footage.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? Already?!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well... There was this cute puppy playing earlier...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oooo! Can I see?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh. You two are hopeless.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Either way... I think we're just about done here!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica `claims` she's been in the town of Centerscore her whole life... But does anyone remember seeing her before sophomore year? I don't! It's almost like she just suddenly appeared!
nodes.text_bbcode: Jessica [color=#3b78e2][i]claims[/i][/color] she's been in the town of Centerscore her whole life... But does anyone remember seeing her before sophomore year? I don't! It's almost like she just suddenly appeared!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Some people say` that she's a sleeper agent, planted by Wilson High!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Some people say[/i][/color] that she's a sleeper agent, planted by Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course, there's no evidence of that... But you've gotta wonder, right?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Wow... You're good...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, I'm just getting started.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Maybe Jessica's `not` a Wilson High sleeper agent... But does anyone else think it's suspicious that she's been cheering at `every` single game that Twin Branches has lost to Wilson?
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe Jessica's [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] a Wilson High sleeper agent... But does anyone else think it's suspicious that she's been cheering at [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] single game that Twin Branches has lost to Wilson?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And has anyone actually seen her birth certificate? I certainly haven't!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is Jessica a notorious sleeper agent planted by Wilson in some kind of incredibly sinister plot to take over our school... Or is she just incredibly suspicious?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The people want answers.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Annnnnnd cut.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Wow. Just wow. I'm not saying I endorse lying and rumor-mongering...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I'm the best. Just admit it.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Honestly? You might just be.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So are we done here?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yep!
Taylor runs around the park, acting rude and belligerent!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Out of my way, everyone! I'm being nice!

nodes.speaker: Old Woman
nodes.text: Excuse me, young lady... Would you mind helping me cross the bridge? I'm very old, you see, and my bones are so frail...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Move it or lose it, granny! I've got places to go and nice things to do!
Taylor shoves the old woman roughly out of the way, sending her falling into the pond!
Angie and $ZOE watch on in horror...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Does she... Does she know what 'nice' means?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Apparently not...
A young girl approaches Taylor and holds out her doll...

nodes.speaker: Little Girl
nodes.text: You're so pretty! Will you play with me?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No time for playing, you potato-faced goblin! I've got nice things to do!
Taylor shoves the little girl aside and rushes across the park! She grabs a Frisbee away from two guys playing!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Playing Frisbee! That's nice, right?

nodes.speaker: Bro
nodes.text: Hey! We were playing with that!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shut your trap, buddy!
A duck waddles towards Taylor, quacking playfully...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, now you wanna go, duck? I'm pretty sure I ate your cousin for dinner!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Okay! And that's a wrap!
Taylor stomps back over.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How'd I do? Pretty good, huh?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...Maybe I can just use some still images.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That bad?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think 'nice' is your strong suit.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well... I guess we're all done here...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, Specs, we're on it. What's next?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, actually, I was hoping to get some footage of you, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Want me to unload on Jessica? Because I have some pretty good burns...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Actually... You won't be doing any talking.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? Why not?!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, I focus-tested this in advance, and over 75% of students have a negative association with your voice.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: They consider it 'intimidating', 'aggressive', and 'scary'. One person described it like 'a cat scratching on a chalkboard, and the cat's nails are made of fiberglass, and also the chalkboard is on fire'.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, what, so because a girl likes to yell and order people around, suddenly she's intimidating and aggressive?!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Um... Would you mind not shouting so much? It's kind of freaking me out.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine. I won't shout. And I won't talk. So what am I doing?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, I was thinking we could get some nice stock footage of you doing nice, friendly things... You know, to splice in under the voice over.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What `kind` of friendly things? And so help me if you say kissing a baby, because I am not going near one of those germ-pocalypses...
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#3b78e2][i]kind[/i][/color] of friendly things? And so help me if you say kissing a baby, because I am not going near one of those germ-pocalypses...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We'll cross kissing babies off the list.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So what am I doing?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well... I was kind of hoping you could figure that out... I mean, we are in this big, lush park...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, Taylor, look around! There's a `million` nice things to do!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, Taylor, look around! There's a [color=#3b78e2][i]million[/i][/color] nice things to do!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, fine, just keep the glitter in your purse, okay? I'm on it.
Taylor turns to survey the park.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay... Do nice things... How hard can it be?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you sure? Don't you want me to go after Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE, do you know what the hawk said to the drowning koala?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: 'Play to your strengths, kid.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's... Really dark...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it's nature. The point is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, shouldn't the hawk at least `try` to help? Does the koala have a family? I hope there aren't koala babies...
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, shouldn't the hawk at least [color=#3b78e2][i]try[/i][/color] to help? Does the koala have a family? I hope there aren't koala babies...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE! Focus! The point is, your strength is saying nice things about people! So we should channel that and have you say nice things about me? Got it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think so... I'm just still kind of worried about that koala...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...He swam to shore and lived a long and happy life.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay! Yay! Now let's film this ad!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Take it away, Angie!
Angie starts filming...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $ZOE, what can you tell me about Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, let's see! Taylor is outgoing, charismatic, and super likable!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As cheerleading captain, she always treated us with respect and compassion, at least compared to `some` people...
nodes.text_bbcode: As cheerleading captain, she always treated us with respect and compassion, at least compared to [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] people...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I'm sure as President, she'd do a great job of making Twin Branches the best high school `ever!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'm sure as President, she'd do a great job of making Twin Branches the best high school [color=#3b78e2][i]ever![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Vote Taylor and vote for a better future! Yay!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Aaaaand cut!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How'd I do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sweeter than a mouthful of sugar. I loved it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You think I'm outgoing, charismatic and likable?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think you can be.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why'd I ever pick on you? You're great as an ego booster!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ahem... Can we just focus on finishing this ad?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you sure? I thought you said I was bad at being mean...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's why it's perfect! Everyone just thinks of you as the sweetest, cutest, daintiest little thing...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you suddenly went all pit bull on Jessica, everyone would pay attention!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Well... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Could we just roll this thing?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Remember, $ZOE... Be a pit bull!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right... A pit bull... And not the cute, baby, misunderstood kind...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And, action!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $ZOE, is there anything you'd like to tell us about the candidates in this election?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, yes there is. I'm very concerned about Ben Kale. Everyone knows his campaign is `really` run by Jessica... And is she someone we trust to run the school?
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, yes there is. I'm very concerned about Ben Kale. Everyone knows his campaign is [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] run by Jessica... And is she someone we trust to run the school?

nodes.text: $ZOE glances at Taylor who mouths the word 'pit bull'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica... Uh... Sucks! She's bad! She acts mean and bosses people around and ruined Howard's chance to get into the school of his dreams!
$ZOE looks again at Taylor, who scrunches up her face in a growl...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And... Uh... She bites people! All the time! She's just this mean, biting, dog-person hybrid thing! Don't let Jessica bite our school!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Aaaaaand cut.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How was I?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, you were okay until the stuff about biting...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $ZOE, do you have any proof for your claims?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Proof? Well, not per se...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Then I can't let you guys air this. It's basically slander!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, fine. Thanks for nothing, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Maybe we should focus on finishing this ad?
On Tuesday after school, Taylor stands around, impatiently waiting...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There you are! I've been waiting for, like, five minutes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, sorry! I just had to finish part one of our `super mean plan` to take down Jessica!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, sorry! I just had to finish part one of our [color=#3b78e2][i]super mean plan[/i][/color] to take down Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, I guess it's okay then. What've you got?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Check `this` out!
nodes.text_bbcode: Check [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] out!

nodes.text: $ZOE whips out a baking tray from behind her back!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...Cupcakes. You baked cupcakes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not just `any` cupcakes! Read what they say!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not just [color=#3b78e2][i]any[/i][/color] cupcakes! Read what they say!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: 'J-E-S-S-I-C-A S-M-E-L-L-S'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You like it? I was going to write 'Jessica sucks', but that just seemed so vulgar...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...You don't know the first thing about being mean, do you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Should I have used more sprinkles?
Taylor knocks the tray of cupcakes out of $ZOE's hands! They fly in all directions!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Ahhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why would you do that, Taylor? That was so...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Mean...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now you get it. Nice people bake cupcakes. `Mean` people ruin cupcakes!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now you get it. Nice people bake cupcakes. [color=#3b78e2][i]Mean[/i][/color] people ruin cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... I don't think Jessica has any cupcakes to ruin...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, we'll ruin something more valuable than her cupcakes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Her cookies?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! Her reputation!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I get it. We'll spread some mean rumors about her, like maybe she hates volunteering with the homeless!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...What is it like in that head of yours, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's pretty nice...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: As much as I'd love to just spread some juicy rumors about her, unfortunately, it won't be that easy. The world's changed so much since I was Head Cheerleader...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Six months ago?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Back then, all you had to do was whisper some gossip in the right ear, and everyone would be talking about it by that afternoon...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But these days, everyone gets all their gossip from that stupid `Dirty Dish` website!
nodes.text_bbcode: But these days, everyone gets all their gossip from that stupid [color=#3b78e2][i]Dirty Dish[/i][/color] website!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's hard to believe that some site that just sprang up overnight totally governs our social lives...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Welcome to Jessica's World, $ZOE. It sucks.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And unfortunately, she and Ben have the upper hand. The Dirty Dish has posted stupid rumors about how I'm a loud, pushy, loser nerd!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's seriously making me look bad! And I have an idea about `who` was behind it...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's seriously making me look bad! And I have an idea about [color=#3b78e2][i]who[/i][/color] was behind it...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now we're not going to just give up without a fight. Oh no. We're going to fight fire with fire.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're making our own gossip web site?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I asked Brendan to do that, but he just spent the whole time playing 'Ogres 'N' Elves Online'. It's what happens when he gets near a computer.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No... Today, we're `making a campaign ad!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No... Today, we're [color=#3b78e2][i]making a campaign ad![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Well, that's fun too!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, it's more than fun. I've gotten us some top-grade film equipment and permission to air the ad on all school channels!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We've only got one shot at this though, so we're gonna have to do it right.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Luckily for us, we've got the very best campaign manager in Twin Branches history helping us out!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, we will... Right after I text her...
A few minutes later, Angie walks shyly over to them...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hi guys...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Angie! You're helping us with this?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, I should be totally neutral, but... I kind of owe Taylor a big favor...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I saved her butt from a rampaging swamp whelp. It's an Ogres 'N' Elves thing. `No big deal!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I saved her butt from a rampaging swamp whelp. It's an Ogres 'N' Elves thing. [color=#3b78e2][i]No big deal![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She's promised to edit the ad and do the voice-over and everything!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I know I'm supposed to abstain from any direct campaigning... But making a commercial is just so much fun!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sure thing! First, let's film $ZOE's part.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now... I'm thinking the best thing for you to do is...

nodes.prompt: The best thing for you to do is...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: The best thing for you to do is...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Nick, Sam's boyfriend, has graciously offered to be your campaign manager...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh-huh. That `is` true...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh-huh. That [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] true...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But we all know what's really going on! Tell me, Sara...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Have you stopped making out with him yet?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, that's a trick question if I've ever heard one...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: As you said, Nick is `Sam's` boyfriend.
nodes.text_bbcode: As you said, Nick is [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam's[/i][/color] boyfriend.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And we'd never do anything to hurt her...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Are you sure? You're absolutely certain the long nights making campaign posters and the hot, heavy stress of the election haven't driven you into each other's arms?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: So you are `still` making out with Nick?
nodes.text_bbcode: So you are [color=#e23b3b][i]still[/i][/color] making out with Nick?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, well, well... The truth comes out...
Andrew starts clapping.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Presidential candidate and homewrecker, everyone...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It doesn't matter what you say, Andrew...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Nick has been nothing but the perfect gentleman and campaign manager, and he and Sam are stronger than ever! They're a good couple.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: He's helping me because he believes in what I have to say...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And that's because I want to win...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I want to make a difference!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, that's all we have time for. There you have her... `Sara Kessler for President!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that's all we have time for. There you have her... [color=#e23b3b][i]Sara Kessler for President![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Stay tuned! Next up, after the break, is Ben!
The camera feed stops in a second, and that's exactly how long it takes for Sara's exhilaration to disappear and for anger to take its place.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What was `that?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What was [color=#3b78e2][i]that?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Why were you badgering me with all those `personal` questions?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Why were you badgering me with all those [color=#3b78e2][i]personal[/i][/color] questions?!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I was making good news, Sara... And by the look of it, you should be `thanking` me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I was making good news, Sara... And by the look of it, you should be [color=#e23b3b][i]thanking[/i][/color] me.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Why's that?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Before me, you were just a boring nobody without a social life or a boyfriend...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I made you look interesting, better, `dimensional...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I made you look interesting, better, [color=#e23b3b][i]dimensional...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: `Scandalous...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Scandalous...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Exactly. Now, if you'll excuse me... I have other interviews to prep for, other candidates to badger, other reputations to build up...
