Andrew makes a dramatic exit, just as Nick comes up to Sara.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That guy is such a jerk!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: He is. But as much as I hate to admit it, he did help you.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: He made your interview colorful. This kind of drama tends to attract voters...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: There's no way I'm `thanking` him...
nodes.text_bbcode: There's no way I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]thanking[/i][/color] him...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You don't have to... Even though he asked the questions, you're the one who said all the right things.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You were perfect up there...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, I couldn't have done it without your help...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thank you so much for everything you've done...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I've never had anyone believe in me the way you have...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I didn't think I could do this, but with you by my side, I...
Sara feels suddenly warm and bright. Her heartbeat quickens.
For one moment, she looks up at Nick's face and wonders...
Their faces come closer...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Is this actually happening?!
...And closer...
But at the last second, Nick pulls away.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Sara...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But I can't.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I love Sam, and I can't do this to her.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I know. It's not right.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And I meant what I said earlier. You and Sam are a good couple. I don't want to break that up.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Maybe once this election is over... We shouldn't hang out...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right.
An awkward silence hangs in the air. Nick looks down at his feet.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But hey... That doesn't mean we're not friends...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And I still have an election to win...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And I still have an election to help you win...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So until then... Presidency, here I come!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I can't take this anymore! This interview is a sham, and it's over!
Sara rips the microphone off her shirt and strides offstage angrily.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, there you have it, folks... `Sara Kessler for President!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, there you have it, folks... [color=#e23b3b][i]Sara Kessler for President![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Stay tuned! Next up, after the break, is Ben!
The camera feed stops, and Andrew steps backstage where Sara is waiting, furious.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What was `that?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What was [color=#3b78e2][i]that?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Why were you badgering me with all those `personal` questions?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Why were you badgering me with all those [color=#3b78e2][i]personal[/i][/color] questions?!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I was making good news, Sara.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You did great by the way! The drama, the scandal, the anger! It's all there!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: All that raw emotion!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I mean, I take `some` credit for bringing it out of you, but... That's show business...
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, I take [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] credit for bringing it out of you, but... That's show business...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's not `show business.` It's an `election,` and you made me look bad!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]show business.[/i][/color] It's an [color=#3b78e2][i]election,[/i][/color] and you made me look bad!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No, sweetheart, `you` made you look bad.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, sweetheart, [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] made you look bad.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Now, if you'll excuse me... I have other interviews to prep for, other candidates to badger, other images to tear down...
Andrew makes a dramatic exit, just as Nick comes up to Sara.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: The nerve of that guy!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: He's a real jerk all right.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I blew that interview, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, uh... It wasn't `great`, but we can `try` to recover...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, uh... It wasn't [color=#e23b3b][i]great[/i][/color], but we can [color=#e23b3b][i]try[/i][/color] to recover...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That doesn't sound too encouraging...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Nonsense... It'll just take a few more nights of poster-making and crowd-waving...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I hope I still have a chance at the Presidency...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Because I can't give up now!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's so cute that you're flustered!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: So you admit you do have a crush on Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I never said `that!` You... You're making me sound weird!
nodes.text_bbcode: I never said [color=#3b78e2][i]that![/i][/color] You... You're making me sound weird!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Too bad...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Because if he likes you at all, he'll be `really` upset by the answer to this next question...
nodes.text_bbcode: Because if he likes you at all, he'll be [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] upset by the answer to this next question...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's so cute that you're flustered!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: So you admit you do have a crush on Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I never said `that!` You... You're making me sound weird!
nodes.text_bbcode: I never said [color=#3b78e2][i]that![/i][/color] You... You're making me sound weird!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Too bad...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Because if he likes you at all, he'll be `really` upset by the answer to this next question...
nodes.text_bbcode: Because if he likes you at all, he'll be [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] upset by the answer to this next question...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: There's nothing going on between me and Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Ouch. Here's hoping he doesn't like you at all...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Because he'll be `really` upset by the answer to this next question...
nodes.text_bbcode: Because he'll be [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] upset by the answer to this next question...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Now tell me...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Would you classify your crush on hot, swimmer-boy Cameron as completely one-sided or an impossible dream?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't want to date just anyone... I want to date someone special.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: A girl has to have standards, after all...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I see your standards `must` be set `very high`...
nodes.text_bbcode: I see your standards [color=#e23b3b][i]must[/i][/color] be set [color=#e23b3b][i]very high[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Why do you say that?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, they must be if you've got your sights set on one of Twin Branches's most eligible guys...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, `excuse me...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]excuse me...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: If I were you, I would have stuck with 'man-hater'...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No one wants an antisocial shut-in running our school...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hey, that doesn't mean I wouldn't make a great President!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: That's kind of exactly what it means.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hey...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But this is getting tedious!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: On to better, cuter, `more eligible` things...
nodes.text_bbcode: On to better, cuter, [color=#e23b3b][i]more eligible[/i][/color] things...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm, uh... Antisocial?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't `hate guys...` I'm just...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't [color=#3b78e2][i]hate guys...[/i][/color] I'm just...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, you're very forthcoming.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm not going to lie to the public over something as silly as this.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's hardly a silly matter.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You hate guys so much that you refuse to have a boyfriend. With that kind of thinking, you're going to lose a lot of votes...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Really? I've done my research, and no one's name has come up...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Is it someone we know?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh, no... I, uh, had a thing with this guy...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What's his name?
Sara looks around desperately.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Um... Boom Mike.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No, wait, I mean... `Mike Boom!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, wait, I mean... [color=#3b78e2][i]Mike Boom![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Lying to the public already?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's already pretty bad that you hate guys so much that you refuse to have a boyfriend...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh... That's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So, are you ready to start going through the questions?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, then it's a good thing we're meeting early to talk about it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Now, you're going to have an interview with Brendan after lunch. Try not to worry.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Brendan's a nice guy, so he's just going to lob you a few easy questions about your platform and what you're running for.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Okay, I think I can do that...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Unless I get super nervous or forget what to say or start hyperventilating...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's normal to be nervous. You just need to figure out a way to calm yourself down. When I have an interview, I go through my checklist.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Checklist?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: A list of things that will clear my mind and prepare me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: First, I `breathe in.`
nodes.text_bbcode: First, I [color=#e23b3b][i]breathe in.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Next, I force myself to `relax all the muscles in my body` at once...
nodes.text_bbcode: Next, I force myself to [color=#e23b3b][i]relax all the muscles in my body[/i][/color] at once...

nodes.text: Nick shakes himself out.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And last, I tell myself the most important thing of all!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Don't mess with your hair.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Don't mess with your hair.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That's your big secret? 'Don't mess with your hair'?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, hair-messing is one of the way people can instantly tell you're nervous.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah. For `girls.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. For [color=#3b78e2][i]girls.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: For `everyone.`
nodes.text_bbcode: For [color=#e23b3b][i]everyone.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay... Ready for your first question?
Sara takes in a deep breath and relaxes. She nods.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sara, what do you think is the most pressing issue at Twin Branches today?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I think it's pretty obvious... There is a large gaping `hole` in our cafeteria floor at the moment...
nodes.text_bbcode: I think it's pretty obvious... There is a large gaping [color=#3b78e2][i]hole[/i][/color] in our cafeteria floor at the moment...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's a good topic to bring up. The follow-up question will probably be... What are you going to do about it?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well...
They run through Sara's interview questions for the next twenty minutes.
At the end, Nick whistles his approval.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: See? You know your stuff. You'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You think so? What if he asks me a question that I don't know how to answer?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `If` he asks you something you don't have an answer for, then just stay calm.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]If[/i][/color] he asks you something you don't have an answer for, then just stay calm.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The best thing for your campaign is to spin his questions. Use them to make yourself sound like a great candidate.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But honestly, you'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're strong and smart and determined...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How can anybody `not` like you?
nodes.text_bbcode: How can anybody [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] like you?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks, Nick...
Later that day...
Sara sits in a cushy chair as she nervously waits in the auditorium for Brendan to arrive.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'll be fine... It's just going to be Brendan and the camera. No one else... No need to be nervous...
Andrew takes the chair across from Sara and gives her a winning smile.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Andrew? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'll be your interviewer.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What about Brendan?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's unfortunate, but I'm the only person who can conduct these Presidential interviews without bias...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Of all the people on the newspaper staff, I'm the only one who can fairly represent every candidate.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Brendan's dating Taylor, Denni's dating Colt, Nick's your campaign manager, and Angie's got, you know, her weird thing with Justin...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What's wrong? You look positively green.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No, I'm just nervous...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'll go easy on you.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The video will start in 3...
Sara feels herself tense up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What was Nick's technique?!

nodes.prompt: Make your choice! How does Nick calm himself?!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And... `Action!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And... [color=#e23b3b][i]Action![/i][/color]

nodes.text: News fanfare plays, and Andrew sits up in his chair and leans towards Sara.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Good morning, Twin Branches! Welcome to the Presidential interviews! I'm here right now with candidate `Sara Kessler`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Good morning, Twin Branches! Welcome to the Presidential interviews! I'm here right now with candidate [color=#e23b3b][i]Sara Kessler[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Sara, is there anything you'd like to say before we `dive` right in?
nodes.text_bbcode: Sara, is there anything you'd like to say before we [color=#e23b3b][i]dive[/i][/color] right in?

nodes.text: Sara breathes in, relaxes her muscles, and puts her hands in her lap.
She sits up straight and smiles for the camera.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'd like to say... Good afternoon, Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And I hope you strongly consider voting for me!
Sara twirls some of her hair with her fingers, then abruptly stops.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh... I'd like to, uh, say...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Good morning?
Andrew smiles.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No need to be nervous, Sara... It's just your entire political career!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah... How about we just move onto the questions?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Fair enough.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Now, Sara, I'd like to run through your campaign platform, ask you what you believe in, and hear what changes you'd make to the school...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, I have a lot of ideas...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But that's `boring!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But that's [color=#e23b3b][i]boring![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh, what?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'm going to ask you what the public wants to know!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Rumor has it that you've never had a boyfriend...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't have a lot of friends as it is, and I already have a reputation for being too focused on swimming...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, when you put it that way... You do kind of sound antisocial...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm doomed...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, you aren't!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're not antisocial, you're shy!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Is there a difference?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, one makes you prone to sociopathy, and the other makes you cute.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh, I `see...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I [color=#3b78e2][i]see...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Unfortunately, you will have to be more engaging during your upcoming interview to dispel these rumors...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Or worse, ugly!
Nick stares at Sara for a second, then starts laughing.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Stop laughing! This is a real concern I have.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know... I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And you're right... There's a positive correlation between how attractive candidates are and how much people want to vote for them.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But Sara, you've got nothing to worry about!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You `are` pretty!
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] pretty!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yes! You're a knockout! You're face is perfect...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I mean... Er... You know, for campaigning and stuff.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks, Nick...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You'll be fine as long as you survive your upcoming interview...

nodes.title: Sara's Story
nodes.subtitle: So, campaign manager... What do you think of those polls?

nodes.text: The same day, Sara is walking to class when everyone around her gets a text about `The Dirty Dish...
That's when the whispering starts...
Sara sees the cheerleaders staring at her as she passes...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That's her?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah... Can you believe it?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: She's `never` had one?!
nodes.text_bbcode: She's [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] had one?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I know, right! She's completely lame...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Are people talking about me?
At lunch, Sara sits with the swim team.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Have you girls heard any rumors about me lately?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? Sara, there have been rumors about you all morning!
